# Regulatory Regions 
## Cleaning up dataframe
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggh4x)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggbeeswarm)
  library(tidyr)
  })

RR_df<- read_csv("data/Regulatory_Regions/final_RR_df1.csv") %>%
  mutate(
         Sex = case_when(
           Sex == "M"~ "Male",
           Sex == "F" ~ "Female"
         ),
         Organ = case_when(
           Organ == "Fin_clip_caudal" ~ "Caudal_Fin",
           Organ == "All_organs" ~ "Multi_organ",
           TRUE ~ Organ
         ))

RR_df <- RR_df%>%
  filter( !is.na(label),                     # remove rows with label NA
    !(label == "TE" & is.na(class))    # remove rows where label is TE and class is NA # remove any NA labels
  ) %>%
  separate(Probe, c("chr","start","end"), sep = ":", remove = F) %>%
  mutate(chr = factor(chr, levels=c(1:25))) 

RR_df <- RR_df %>%
  filter(ID != "overlap_all")

# clean up dataframe for single organs 
RR_df <- RR_df%>%
  filter(
    (ID == "Brain" & Organ == "Brain") |
    (ID == "Intestines" & Organ == "Intestines") |
    (ID == "Caudal_Fin" & Organ == "Caudal_Fin") |
    !(ID %in% c("Brain", "Intestines", "Caudal_Fin"))  # keep all others as-is
  )


```

### Tisue specific selected CpGs 
```{r}


df_single<- RR_df %>%
  filter(ID != "overlap_single")


#-----------------------------------
# Colour palette (master_pal already defined)
#-----------------------------------
# Ensure master_pal includes Organs, Sex, and labels as in your previous code

#-----------------------------------
# 1 Regulatory region methylation per Organ
#-----------------------------------
p.label_organ <- df_single %>%
  filter(!is.na(label)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = label, y = methylation, colour = ID, group = ID)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", size = 0.3, colour="#999999", position=position_dodge(0.9)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size=1.5, position=position_dodge(0.9)) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom="errorbar", width=0.15, size=0.7, position=position_dodge(0.9)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = master_pal) +
  labs(y="Methylation (%)", x="", colour="") +
  plot_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=20, hjust=1))
p.label_organ
#-----------------------------------
# 2 Sex-specific methylation patterns
#-----------------------------------
p.sex <- df_single %>%
  filter(!is.na(label), !is.na(Sex)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = label, y = methylation, colour = Sex, group = Sex)) +
  stat_summary(fun=mean, geom="line", size=0.3, colour="#999999", position=position_dodge(0.9)) +
  stat_summary(fun=mean, geom="point", size=1.5, position=position_dodge(0.9)) +
  stat_summary(fun.data=mean_se, geom="errorbar", width=0.15, size=0.7, position=position_dodge(0.9)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = master_pal) +
  labs(y="Methylation (%)", x="", colour="Sex") +
  plot_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=20, hjust=1))+
  facet_nested(~ ID )
p.sex

#-----------------------------------
# 3 Age-related methylation trends per label
#-----------------------------------

p.age <- df_single %>%

  ggplot(aes(x = Age, y = methylation, colour = ID, group=ID)) +
  stat_summary(fun=mean, geom="line", size=0.3, colour="#999999", position=position_dodge(0.9)) +
  stat_summary(fun=mean, geom="point", size=1.5, position=position_dodge(0.9)) +
  stat_summary(fun.data=mean_se, geom="errorbar", width=0.15, size=0.7, position=position_dodge(0.9)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values=master_pal) +
  labs(y="Methylation (%)", x="Age (binned)", colour="Organ") +
  plot_theme +
  facet_nested(~label, scales="free_y")
p.age

#-----------------------------------
# 4 TE class 
#-----------------------------------

p.TE<- df_single %>%
filter(label=="TE") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = class, y = methylation, colour = ID, group=ID)) +
  stat_summary(fun=mean, geom="line", size=0.3, colour="#999999", position=position_dodge(0.9)) +
  stat_summary(fun=mean, geom="point", size=1.5, position=position_dodge(0.9)) +
  stat_summary(fun.data=mean_se, geom="errorbar", width=0.15, size=0.7, position=position_dodge(0.9)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values=master_pal) +
  labs(y="Methylation (%)", x="", colour="TE Class") +
  plot_theme 
p.TE

#-----------------------------------
# 5 CpG-level variability per label × Organ
#-----------------------------------
p.variability <- df_single %>%
  filter(!is.na(label)) %>%
  group_by(ID,  label) %>%
  summarise(methylation_sd = sd(methylation, na.rm=TRUE), .groups="drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = label, y = methylation_sd, colour = ID, group = ID)) +
  stat_summary(fun=mean, geom="line", size=0.3, colour="#999999", position=position_dodge(0.9)) +
  stat_summary(fun=mean, geom="point", size=1.5, position=position_dodge(0.9)) +
  stat_summary(fun.data=mean_se, geom="errorbar", width=0.15, size=0.7, position=position_dodge(0.9)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = master_pal) +
  labs(y="Methylation SD", x="", colour="Organ") +
  plot_theme 
p.variability

```

#Chromosome 4
```{r}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggh4x)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(tidyverse)
})


methylation_best_cpgs1<- methylation_best_cpgs %>%
 
  separate(tile, c("chr","start","end"), sep=":", remove=F ) %>%
  mutate(chr = factor(chr, levels = c(1:25)),
         start=as.numeric(start),
         end=as.numeric(end)) %>%
  dplyr::rename( "Probe" ="tile" ) %>%
  left_join(Final_all_cpgs_df, by =  "Probe") %>%
   filter(ID != "overlap_all") %>%
  mutate(
         ID = factor(ID)) %>%
  filter(# make sure each ID has correct organs 
    !(ID %in% c("Brain", "Caudal_Fin", "Intestines")) |
      Organ == ID
  )


chr_counts <- methylation_best_cpgs1 %>%
  distinct(ID, chr, Probe) %>%
  dplyr::count(ID, chr)

# Number of cpgs pe chromosome


enrichment_pal <- c("#0072B2", "beige", "#D55E00")

p <- chr_counts %>%
  filter(ID != "overlap_all") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = chr, y = ID, fill = n)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = enrichment_pal
  ) +
  labs(fill = "CpG count", x = "Chromosome", y = "") +
  plot_theme

p


dir.create(paste0(output_directory,"/Chromosome_4"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(output_directory, "/Chromosome_4/best_cpg_groupings_chromosome_number.png"),
  plot =p,
  height = 6,
  width = 12,
  dpi = 400
)

# pobability of proes on chomosome 4 between IDS 
 methylation_best_cpgs1 %>%
  distinct(ID, chr, Probe) %>%
  dplyr::count(ID, chr) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  filter(chr == 4)

 # methylation of chr 4 comapred to others 
p <- methylation_best_cpgs1 %>%
  mutate(chr_group = ifelse(chr == 4, "chr4", "other")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = methylation, fill = chr_group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_manual(values =  okabe_ito)+
  facet_wrap(~ ID) +
  labs(fill = "")+
  plot_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
p

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(output_directory, "/Chromosome_4/best_cpg_groupings_chromosome_4_meth_density.png"),
  plot =p,
  height = 6,
  width = 9,
  dpi = 400
)

# where are the CpGs on chromosome 4 

 p <- methylation_best_cpgs1 %>%
  filter(chr == 4) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(start), y = methylation, colour = ID)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ ID, ncol = 1) +
  plot_theme+
  
  scale_colour_manual(values =  okabe_ito_palette(5))+
  labs(colour = "", x = "Start Position")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=25,hjust=1),
        legend.position = "none")

 p
 
 

ggsave(
  filename = paste0(output_directory, "/Chromosome_4/best_cpg_groupings_chromosome_4_position.png"),
  plot =p,
  height = 9,
  width = 6,
  dpi = 400
)

## 

chr4_centromere <- 25975534

p<-methylation_best_cpgs1 %>%
  filter(chr == "4") %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = start / 1e6,          # scale to Mb
    ymin = 0,                  # fixed vertical line for each ID
    ymax = 1,                  # can be adjusted for stacking
    colour = methylation
  )) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = as.numeric(ID)-0.4, ymax = as.numeric(ID)+0.4), alpha=0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = chr4_centromere / 1e6, linetype="dashed", colour="black") +
   scale_colour_gradientn(
    colours = enrichment_pal
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 1:5,
    labels = levels(factor(methylation_best_cpgs1$ID))
  ) +
  labs(x="Chromosome 4 position (Mb)", y=NULL) +
  plot_theme

p
ggsave(
  filename = paste0(output_directory, "/Chromosome_4/best_cpg_groupings_chromosome_4_position2.png"),
  plot =p,
  height = 6,
  width = 9,
  dpi = 400
)
```
